The Planner then realized the need to check if Osiris is part of the Memphite pantheon, specifically through the Ptah-Sokar-Osiris triad.

The Planner then instructed WebSurfer again, this time focusing on Memphite sources. Instead, the Planner continued to ask WebSurfer to perform more searches without making progress, leading to redundant efforts and not reaching a definitive conclusion.

So, the main mistake was the Planner's failure to synthesize information and adapt the strategy when WebSurfer's searches weren't yielding the required explicit confirmation. The Planner should have either recognized that further searches weren't helping or brought in another agent to cross-verify the information, thus avoiding the repetitive and unproductive loop.
